clean_repro.probe: Create collection test_rename_dst, then rename test_rename_src to test_rename_dst
clean_repro.observed: Rename request correctly failed with error code 65535: 'duplicated new collection name default:test_rename_dst with other collection name or alias'. API properly prevents name collision.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/create" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "test_rename_dst", "dimension": 4}' && curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/rename" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"collectionName": "test_rename_src", "newCollectionName": "test_rename_dst", "dbName": "default"}'

violated_assumptions: Oracle assumes rename should succeed regardless of target name existence
Oracle treats name collision prevention as a defect rather than correct data integrity protection
Oracle expects rename to override existing collections, which would cause data loss

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_state_collections_rename_001 - 'source collection exists AND new collection name does NOT exist'
constraint_id: milvus_type_collections_rename_001 - 'collectionName is non-empty string AND newCollectionName is non-empty string'

source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:集合重命名功能正确实现了目标名称存在性检查,防止名称冲突。这是数据完整性保护的核心功能,非缺陷。

verdicts.rationale: Oracle 错误地将名称冲突防护视为缺陷。契约明确定义集合重命名要求'新集合名称不存在'(milvus_state_collections_rename_001),API 正确拒绝了会造成名称冲突的重命名请求,返回错误码 65535 及明确错误信息。这是数据库系统基础的数据完整性保护机制,防止覆盖现有集合导致数据丢失。若允许此操作,将破坏命名空间唯一性约束,造成严重数据风险。API 行为完全符合契约与预期,非遗漏。
